resources.string: NoporIS runs a second persona in one isolated managed profile — separate encrypted storage and process boundary — chosen as a clean (hardened) flavor or a Google-Play flavor. The Google-Play flavor is the LESS-private side by construction: it phones home to Google. This is separation and convenience, not privacy on that side. A rooted or kernel-compromised host defeats the separation. It attests the phone, not the persona. An app on stock Android — never a replacement OS. Design only; unaudited.
